influences.name: Eddie Floyd
influences.context: Eddie Floyd's Knock on Wood has been number 1 since I can remember. Killer tune.

influences.name: King Tubby
influences.context: It's a reference to old dub recs like King Tubby Meets Rockers Uptown but ultimately it came to represent how our thoughts on recording evolved in order to make the best rec possible.

influences.name: Woody Guthrie
influences.context: Donovan's initial interest in Woody Guthrie, the Beat poets, and the itinerant lifestyle they led is an obvious parallel to Dylan.
